text: FORM 18 FEE* APPLICATION FOR EXTENSION OF TIME [ See rule 15 ] 1Insert (in full) name I (or We)1 ________________________________________ address and nationality. hereby apply for _____________ months' extension of time :- 2Quote number and year Under Rule 15 for leaving a certified copy of the design filed of application of design with the British or convention or group of countries or Inter governmental organisation application in respect of design application No. _____________________ The reason for making this application are as follows :- __________________________________________ __________________________________________ __________________________________________ My (or Our) address for service in India is :- ________________________________________________ ________________________________________________ ________________________________________________ Dated this ______________ day of ____________ 2000 3To be signed by the (Signed)3________________________________________ applicant or authorised agent. TO THE CONTROLLER OF DESIGNS, THE PATENT OFFICE, CALCUTTA. * Rs. 200.00 per month. -- 1 of 1 --
